newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Egis in focus in mixed Budapest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Egis in focus in mixed Budapest bourse.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mixed in rangebound, calm trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday as the market was seeking new factors to trade on, traders said.
Traders said the market shrugged off news of Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart surgery.
The BUX index ended at 1,544.15 points, up 26.64.
BUX index futures ended lower for the four nearest maturities by 25.50 to 67.50 points, they were unchanged at 4,140.00 points for December 1997 and firmed 30.50 points to 4,370.00 for June 1998.
Spot share turnover totalled 989.4 million forints, of which pharmaceuticals Egis accounted for 586.1 million.
The price movements of Egis which moved sharply to both directions this week, calmed down and the share firmed a thin five forints to end the session at 11,100.

Chemical company Borsodchem 's announcement on Thursday that it has almost completed a 1.5 billion forints investment the test run of which occurred on Wednesday, had no impact. In thin trade Borsodchem ended at 2,820 forints, up 10.
